lp001.e: Because of the rain, she watched a movie at home.
lp001.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What did the woman do yesterday?
Man: What did you do yesterday?
Woman: I was going to go shopping with a friend, but it was raining, so I watched a movie at home.
Man: I see.

lp002.e: He couldn't sleep because of the noise.
lp002.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Why is the man tired?
Woman: You look tired. Are you busy at work?
Man: No, work isn't that busy.
Woman: Then why?
Man: Last night the room next door was noisy, and I couldn't sleep well.

lp003.t:
A man and a woman are talking. When is the woman's birthday?
Man: When is your birthday?
Woman: In May.
Man: What day in May?
Woman: The 14th. Oh, no. Today is the 14th, so it's the day after tomorrow. The 16th.

lp004.e: A family of 5 (even though the sister no longer lives with them).
lp004.t:
A woman and a man are talking. How many people are in the man's family?
Woman: How many people are in your family?
Man: My parents, my older sister, my younger brother and me.
Woman: That's a lively family.
Man: But my sister got married, and she doesn't live with us now.

lp005.e: She wants to work at a Japanese company.
lp005.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Why is the woman studying Japanese?
Man: Why are you studying Japanese? Do you like anime?
Woman: I like anime too, but it's because I want to work at a Japanese company.
Man: I see. Good luck.

lp006.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What time does the man get up every morning?
Woman: What time do you get up every morning?
Man: At 6. I leave home at 7.
Woman: That's early. I get up at 7:30.

lp007.t:
A male student and a female student are talking. Where did the female student go during the summer holidays?
Man: Did you go back to your country for the summer holidays?
Woman: No, I didn't. I went to Kyoto with friends.
Man: What about Osaka?
Woman: I want to go to Osaka in winter.

lp008.t:
A woman and a man are talking. How does the man come to the office?
Woman: Do you come to the office by train?
Man: I used to come by train, but now I come by bicycle.
Woman: Isn't it far?
Man: It's about 20 minutes. It's good for your health.

lp009.e: She prefers near the station, even if it's small.
lp009.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What kind of apartment does the woman say she wants?
Man: Are you looking for a new apartment?
Woman: Yes. I'd like a big one, but they're expensive.
Man: Apartments far from the station are cheap.
Woman: Far from the station isn't really... Even if it's small, I'd like one near the station.

lp010.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Which season does the man like best?
Woman: Which season do you like? I like spring.
Man: Spring is nice too. But I like autumn best.
Woman: Why?
Man: Because the food is delicious.

lp011.e: She goes back to her country on December 20th.
lp011.t:
A man and a woman are talking. When will the woman go back to her country?
Man: Are you going back to your country for the winter holidays?
Woman: Yes, I'm going back on December 20th.
Man: When will you come back to Japan?
Woman: January 10th.

lp012.e: 7 to 10 is 3 hours, minus 1 hour of TV: 2.
lp012.t:
A woman and a man are talking. How many hours did the man study yesterday?
Woman: Did you study for the test yesterday?
Man: Yes. I studied from 7 in the evening.
Woman: Until what time?
Man: Until 10. But I watched TV for an hour in the middle.

lp013.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What does the woman like?
Man: Do you like sports?
Woman: I don't really like playing them. But I like watching them.
Man: What do you watch?
Woman: I watch a lot of soccer.

lp014.e: He had no time because of the meeting.
lp014.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Why didn't the man eat lunch?
Woman: Did you eat lunch?
Man: No, I didn't.
Woman: Does your stomach hurt?
Man: No, I'm fine. The meeting was long, and I didn't have time.

lp015.t:
A man and a woman are talking. How old is the man's younger sister?
Woman: How old is your younger sister?
Man: She's five years younger than me.
Woman: Excuse me, but how old are you?
Man: I'm 25.

lp016.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What will the woman do at the party?
Man: Are you going to sing at the party tomorrow?
Woman: Singing is a bit... I'll play the piano.
Man: Great. I'm looking forward to it.

lp017.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Where did the man lose his wallet?
Man: My wallet is gone.
Woman: Where did you lose it?
Man: I thought it was on the train, but when I asked the station staff, it wasn't there.
Woman: Then wasn't it at the café we were just at?
Man: Oh, that's right. I put it on the chair at the café.

lp018.t:
A woman and a man are talking. How many times a week does the man go to the pool?
Woman: Do you go to the pool often?
Man: Yes. I used to go once a week, but now I go three times.
Woman: That's great.

lp019.e: She went home to get her homework.
lp019.t:
A male student and a female student are talking. Why was the female student late?
Man: You're late. Did you oversleep?
Woman: No, I got up on time.
Man: Then was the train late?
Woman: No. After I left home, I realized I had forgotten my homework, so I went back to get it.

lp020.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What food does the man like?
Woman: What Japanese food do you like? Sushi?
Man: I like sushi too, but what I like best is tempura.
Woman: What about ramen?
Man: I don't eat ramen much.

lp021.e: South of the station, next to the supermarket.
lp021.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Where is the woman's house?
Man: Is your house near here?
Woman: Yes, near the station.
Man: Which side of the station?
Woman: South of the station. Next to a big supermarket.

lp022.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What does the man always do on his days off?
Woman: What do you do on your days off?
Man: I usually read books at home.
Woman: Don't you go out?
Man: Sometimes I take a walk in the park, but I'm mostly at home.

lp023.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What did the woman buy?
Man: What did you buy at the department store?
Woman: I wanted to buy shoes, but there weren't any good ones.
Man: So you didn't buy anything?
Woman: No, I bought a hat.

lp024.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What time does the meeting start?
Woman: The meeting is at 2, right?
Man: No, the department manager will be late, so it's been pushed back 30 minutes.
Woman: 2:30, then. Understood.

lp025.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Why did the woman move?
Man: You moved, didn't you? Was your old room small?
Woman: No, it was big and nice.
Man: Then why?
Woman: It was far from my office. Now it's a 10-minute walk to work.

lp026.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What did the man drink?
Woman: What did you drink?
Man: I ordered coffee, but they didn't have any, so I had tea.
Woman: Was it good?
Man: Yes, very.

lp027.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What is the woman's pet?
Man: Do you have a pet? A dog?
Woman: I like dogs, but I can't keep one in my apartment.
Man: Then a cat?
Woman: No, fish. I have three small red fish.

lp028.e: At a university in his country.
lp028.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Where did the man study Japanese?
Woman: Your Japanese is very good. Where did you study it?
Man: I studied it for two years at a university in my country.
Woman: What about a Japanese language school?
Man: I didn't go to one.

lp029.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What time will the woman leave home tomorrow?
Man: What time are you leaving tomorrow?
Woman: My flight is at 10, so I'll leave at 7.
Man: It's an hour to the airport, right? Isn't that early?
Woman: The roads might be crowded.

lp030.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What color bag did the man buy?
Woman: That's a new bag.
Man: Yes. I wanted a black one, but they didn't have any, so I chose brown.
Woman: Brown is nice.

lp031.t:
A male student and a female student are talking. What does the female student say is difficult?
Man: How is your Japanese study going?
Woman: I already know hiragana and katakana.
Man: What about kanji?
Woman: I like kanji. But listening is difficult. Japanese people speak fast.

lp032.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What time did the man go to bed?
Woman: You look sleepy. What time did you go to bed last night?
Man: I was going to go to bed at 12, but the movie was interesting, so I watched it until 2.
Woman: 2? That's late.

lp033.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Where did the woman take the photo?
Man: That's a beautiful photo. Is it a mountain?
Woman: No, it's the sea. The sea in Hokkaido.
Man: Wow, Hokkaido?

lp034.t:
A woman and a man are talking. How much did the man pay for the watch?
Woman: That's a nice watch. Was it expensive?
Man: No, it was 10,000 yen.
Woman: That's cheap.
Man: It's really 20,000 yen, but it was half price.

lp035.t:
A man and a woman are talking. On which days is the woman busy?
Man: Shall we have a meal together next week?
Woman: Sounds good. I'm busy on Monday and Wednesday, but other days are fine.
Man: Then how about Thursday?
Woman: Sure.

lp036.e: He took his child to the doctor.
lp036.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Why was the man absent from work?
Woman: You were off work yesterday. Did you have a cold?
Man: No, my child had a fever, so I took him to the hospital.
Woman: I see. Is he OK now?
Man: Yes, he's better now.

lp037.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What is the woman learning?
Man: What do you do every Saturday?
Woman: I'm learning cooking.
Man: Japanese cooking?
Woman: No, French cooking.

lp038.t:
A woman and a man are talking. How long does it take from the man's house to the station?
Woman: Is the station close to your house?
Man: It takes about 20 minutes on foot.
Woman: That's a little far.
Man: That's why I always go by bicycle. By bicycle it's 5 minutes.

lp039.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Who did the woman go on the trip with?
Man: Did you go on the trip alone?
Woman: No. I was going to go with a friend, but my friend got sick.
Man: So...
Woman: I went with my mother.

lp040.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What doesn't the man like?
Woman: Do you like vegetables?
Man: Yes, I love them.
Woman: What about fruit?
Man: I like fruit too. But I don't really like sweet snacks.

lp041.t:
A man and a woman are talking. On which floor does the woman live?
Man: Which floor of the apartment building do you live on?
Woman: The 5th floor.
Man: Is there an elevator?
Woman: Yes. But sometimes I use the stairs.

lp042.e: He left it on the train.
lp042.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Why doesn't the man have an umbrella?
Woman: It's raining. Where's your umbrella?
Man: I had it in the morning, but I left it on the train.
Woman: Shall I lend you mine?
Man: Thank you very much.

lp043.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Since what age has the woman been studying English?
Man: Your English is very good.
Woman: Thank you. I've been studying it since I was 10.
Man: So not from junior high school.
Woman: No, when I was in elementary school, I went to an English school.

lp044.e: A hot spring in the mountains.
lp044.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Where will the man go this weekend?
Woman: What are you doing this weekend?
Man: I'd like to go to the sea, but it's still cold.
Woman: That's true.
Man: So I'm going to a hot spring in the mountains.

lp045.t:
A man and a woman are talking. About how many hours does the woman sleep every day?
Man: About how many hours do you sleep every day?
Woman: I go to bed at 11 and get up at 6.
Man: Seven hours, then.
Woman: Yes.

lp046.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What has the man lost?
Woman: What are you looking for?
Man: My key. I can't find my house key.
Woman: What about in your bag?
Man: I've already looked in my bag.

lp047.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Why is the woman feeling down?
Man: You look down. What's wrong?
Woman: My test didn't go well.
Man: I see. Let's do our best next time.

lp048.t:
A woman and a man are talking. When did the man come to Japan?
Woman: When did you come to Japan?
Man: In April last year.
Woman: So it's been about a year and a half.
Man: Yes.

lp049.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What did the woman eat for dinner?
Man: What did you have for dinner?
Woman: I was going to have ramen, but the shop was closed.
Man: So...
Woman: I had curry at the shop next door.

lp050.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Why does the man often come to this shop?
Woman: Do you come to this shop often?
Man: Yes, about three times a week.
Woman: Because it's cheap?
Man: It's not cheap. But the staff are kind.

lp051.t:
A man and a woman are talking. When does the woman play tennis?
Man: Do you play tennis every week?
Woman: Yes, on Sunday mornings.
Man: What about Saturdays?
Woman: On Saturdays I have my part-time job.

lp052.t:
A woman and a man are talking. How many people are going on the trip (including the man)?
Woman: How many of you are going on the trip?
Man: At first there were going to be four, but one person can't go anymore.
Woman: So three.
Man: Yes.

lp053.e: A small town near the sea.
lp053.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Where does the woman say she wants to live?
Man: Where do you want to live in the future? Tokyo?
Woman: Tokyo has too many people...
Man: Then where?
Woman: I want to live in a small town near the sea.

lp054.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What is the man studying?
Woman: What are you studying at university? Economics?
Man: No, history.
Woman: Japanese history?
Man: Yes, that's right.

lp055.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Where was the woman's cat?
Man: Did you find your cat?
Woman: Yes. I looked outside the house, but it wasn't there.
Man: Where was it?
Woman: It was sleeping inside the closet.

lp056.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Which train did the man take?
Woman: What time was the train you took this morning?
Man: I usually take the 8 o'clock train, but today I got up early, so I took the 7:30 one.

lp057.e: Her older sister gave it to her.
lp057.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Who gave the woman the present?
Man: That's a lovely necklace.
Woman: Thanks. It's a birthday present.
Man: From your boyfriend?
Woman: No, my older sister gave it to me.

lp058.e: He gets home late from work.
lp058.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Why doesn't the man cook?
Woman: Do you cook?
Man: Not much.
Woman: Don't you like cooking?
Man: It's not that I don't like it, but I get home late because of work.

lp059.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What did the woman take the photo with?
Man: This photo is beautiful. Did you take it with a camera?
Woman: No, with my phone.
Man: Wow, that's amazing.

lp060.t:
A woman and a man are talking. How long does the man study Japanese every day?
Woman: Do you study Japanese every day?
Man: Yes. I study for 30 minutes in the morning and an hour at night.
Woman: So an hour and a half in total.
Man: Yes.

lp061.e: She was on the phone until late.
lp061.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Why is the woman sleepy?
Man: You look sleepy.
Woman: Yes. Last night I talked on the phone with a friend for three hours.
Man: Three whole hours?
Woman: Yes. So I didn't go to bed until 2.

lp062.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What time did the man arrive at the office?
Woman: You were late this morning.
Man: Yes. The train stopped, and I arrived at 9:30.
Woman: The meeting started at 9, didn't it?
Man: Yes, I was 30 minutes late.

lp063.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Where did the woman go on her trip?
Man: Did you go anywhere during the holidays?
Woman: I was going to go to Okinawa, but a typhoon came.
Man: That's too bad.
Woman: So I went to a hot spring nearby.

lp064.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What is the man's older brother's job?
Woman: What does your older brother do?
Man: He was a bank clerk, but now he runs a bakery.
Woman: Wow, a bakery?

lp065.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What did the woman buy?
Man: What's in that bag?
Woman: I bought a dictionary at the bookstore.
Man: Did you buy a magazine too?
Woman: No, I read magazines at the library.

lp066.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What does the man eat every morning?
Woman: Do you have bread for breakfast?
Man: No, rice and miso soup.
Woman: Do you make it every morning?
Man: Yes, it only takes 10 minutes.

lp067.t:
A man and a woman are talking. How many people does the woman live with (in total)?
Man: Do you live alone?
Woman: No, with a friend; there are two of us.
Man: Is it a big apartment?
Woman: Yes. Next month one more person is coming, so there will be three of us.

lp068.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Why did the man come by bus?
Woman: Did you come by bus today? You usually come by bicycle.
Man: Yes. My bicycle broke.
Woman: I see.

lp069.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What day has the meeting been changed to?
Man: The meeting is on Wednesday, right?
Woman: No, the department manager has a business trip on Wednesday, so it's been changed to Thursday.
Man: What time on Thursday?
Woman: The same time.

lp070.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What kind of book is the man reading?
Woman: What are you reading? A novel?
Man: No, a cookbook.
Woman: Do you cook?
Man: Yes, I started recently.

lp071.e: She's picking up her mother at the airport.
lp071.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Why isn't the woman going to the party?
Man: Are you going to the party tonight?
Woman: I'd like to, but I can't.
Man: Work?
Woman: No, my mother is coming from my country, so I'm going to pick her up at the airport.

lp072.t:
A woman and a man are talking. For how many years has the man been studying Japanese?
Woman: Since when have you been studying Japanese?
Man: Since I entered university. I'm in my fourth year now.
Woman: So it's already...
Man: Yes, it's been four years.

lp073.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What date is the woman's birthday party?
Man: Your birthday is on the 20th of this month, right?
Woman: Yes. But I'm having the party on the Saturday before.
Man: The 18th, then.
Woman: Yes.

lp074.e: At the convenience store in the station.
lp074.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Where did the man buy his umbrella?
Woman: That's a new umbrella. Did you buy it at the department store?
Man: No, at the convenience store in the station. It suddenly started raining.

lp075.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What did the woman do on her day off?
Man: What did you do on your day off?
Woman: I was going to go to the sea, but it was cold, so I made a cake at home.
Man: Was it good?
Woman: Yes, very.

lp076.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What floor is the man's apartment on?
Woman: What floor is your new apartment on?
Man: The 8th floor.
Woman: That's high. Is there an elevator?
Man: Yes, there is. You can see the sea from the window.

lp077.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Why did the woman come to Japan?
Man: Why did you come to Japan?
Woman: Because I wanted to study architecture at a Japanese university.
Man: Do you like Japanese buildings?
Woman: Yes, I really like old temples.

lp078.t:
A woman and a man are talking. How many hours did the man sleep?
Woman: Did you sleep well last night?
Man: I went to bed at 10, but I woke up once at 2, and then I couldn't sleep until 4.
Woman: What time did you get up?
Man: At 7.

lp079.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What does the woman want?
Man: What do you want for your birthday?
Woman: I want a new watch.
Man: What about your current watch?
Woman: It's old and often stops.

lp080.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Where did the man eat lunch?
Woman: Where did you eat lunch? In the company cafeteria?
Man: The cafeteria was crowded, so I ate my boxed lunch in the park.
Woman: Well, the weather was nice.

lp081.t:
A man and a woman are talking. About what time will the woman come home?
Man: About what time will you be home today?
Woman: Usually at 7, but today I'm having dinner with friends, so around 10.

lp082.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Why is the man in such good spirits?
Woman: You're in good spirits today.
Man: Yes. My test results were good.
Woman: That's great.

lp083.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What kind of movies does the woman like?
Man: Do you like movies? How about scary movies?
Woman: I don't watch scary ones.
Man: Then what do you watch?
Woman: I like movies that make me laugh.

lp084.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What did the man forget?
Woman: What's wrong?
Man: I have a test today, but I forgot my pencil.
Woman: What about an eraser?
Man: I have an eraser.

lp085.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What time does the woman's work start?
Man: What time does your work start?
Woman: It used to be 9, but from this month it's 8:30.
Man: It's gotten earlier.

lp086.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Why does the man want to move?
Woman: You want to move?
Man: Yes. My current apartment is close to the station and cheap.
Woman: Then why?
Man: The construction next door is noisy.

lp087.t:
A man and a woman are talking. How will the woman go to America?
Man: You're going to America by plane, right?
Woman: Yes. But the airport is far, so I'll stay one night at a hotel near the airport.

lp088.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What is the man's hobby?
Woman: What's your hobby?
Man: It used to be movies, but now it's climbing mountains.
Woman: Every week?
Man: About twice a month.

lp089.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What will the woman drink?
Man: What would you like to drink?
Woman: A hot coffee, please.
Man: I'm sorry, we don't have any hot drinks right now.
Woman: Then an iced tea, please.

lp090.e: With his parents and sister: 3 people.
lp090.t:
A woman and a man are talking. With how many family members is the man traveling?
Woman: Is it a family trip?
Man: Yes. I'm going with my parents and my younger sister.
Woman: What about your younger brother?
Man: My brother can't go because of work.

lp091.e: She went with someone who was lost.
lp091.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Why was the woman late?
Man: You're late. Did something happen?
Woman: At the station I met someone who didn't know the way, and I went with them.
Man: I see. That was kind of you.

lp092.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Where had the man put his key?
Woman: Did you find your key?
Man: Yes. I thought it was in my bag, but it was in my coat pocket.

lp093.t:
A man and a woman are talking. When did the woman get her hair cut?
Man: You got a haircut. Yesterday?
Woman: No, the day before yesterday.
Man: It really suits you.

lp094.t:
A woman and a man are talking. How much will the man save each month from next month?
Woman: Do you save money?
Man: Yes. 30,000 yen every month.
Woman: That's impressive.
Man: But from next month I'll make it 20,000 yen. I bought a car.

lp095.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What is the woman studying?
Man: Are you studying anything lately?
Woman: Yes, I'm studying Chinese.
Man: What about English?
Woman: I studied English in high school.

lp096.t:
A woman and a man are talking. How many minutes does it take from the man's house to his office?
Woman: Is your office far?
Man: 20 minutes by train and a 10-minute walk from the station.
Woman: So about 30 minutes.

lp097.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What has the woman lost?
Man: What are you looking for?
Woman: My gloves. I only have one of them.
Man: Let's look for it together.

lp098.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Why is the man good at cooking?
Woman: You're good at cooking.
Man: Thank you. I used to have a part-time job at a restaurant.
Woman: I see.

lp099.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What time did the woman get up?
Man: You were up early this morning.
Woman: Yes, I got up at 5.
Man: Why?
Woman: To walk my dog.

lp100.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What doesn't the man want to eat?
Woman: What would you like for dinner?
Man: Anything is fine. But I had fish yesterday...
Woman: Then let's have meat.

lp101.t:
A man and a woman are talking. How old is the woman's younger brother?
Man: How old is your younger brother?
Woman: He's in his third year of high school now; he's 18.
Man: So university next year.

lp102.t:
A woman and a man are talking. In which season will the man travel?
Woman: When are you going to Hokkaido? In winter?
Man: Winter is too cold, so I'll go in summer.

lp103.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Why does the woman like that restaurant?
Man: You go to that restaurant a lot. Because it's cheap?
Woman: It's not cheap. But you can see the sea from the window.
Man: That's nice.

lp104.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Where does the man live?
Woman: Where do you live?
Man: I used to live in Tokyo, but now I live in Yokohama.
Woman: Isn't it far from your office?
Man: It's about an hour.

lp105.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What score did the woman get on the test?
Man: How was the test?
Woman: I got 80 points.
Man: That's great.
Woman: It was 20 points better than the last test.

lp106.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What did the man show the photos on?
Woman: Do you have photos from your trip?
Man: The camera photos are on my computer at home. But I have some on my phone too.
Woman: Please show me.

lp107.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Who will the woman play tennis with?
Man: Are you playing tennis on Sunday?
Woman: Yes, with someone from my company.
Man: Do you always play with them?
Woman: I usually play with my older sister, but she's away on a trip.

lp108.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Why is the man tired?
Woman: You look tired.
Man: Yesterday I helped someone move.
Woman: Did you carry a lot of heavy things?
Man: Yes, up to the 5th floor by the stairs.

lp109.t:
A man and a woman are talking. On which days does the woman have Japanese class?
Man: What days do you have Japanese class?
Woman: Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Man: What about Saturdays?
Woman: There's no class on Saturdays.

lp110.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What did the man order?
Woman: What did you get?
Man: I wanted to order the hamburger steak, but it was sold out.
Woman: So?
Man: I ordered spaghetti.

lp111.t:
A man and a woman are talking. How many cats are there at the woman's house?
Man: You have cats, don't you?
Woman: Yes, two.
Man: They must be cute.
Woman: Last week three kittens were born, so now there are five.

lp112.t:
A woman and a man are talking. When will the man get married?
Woman: You're getting married? Congratulations! When?
Man: Next spring.
Woman: In April?
Man: No, in March.

lp113.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Why did the woman buy a bicycle?
Man: You bought a bicycle, didn't you?
Woman: Yes. Bus fares are expensive.
Man: It's good exercise too.

lp114.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What will the man do on his days off?
Woman: Are you going anywhere on your days off next week?
Man: I'm not going anywhere. I'll stay home, writing letters to my family back home, reading books and so on.

lp115.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Since when has the woman lived in Japan?
Man: Have you been in Japan long?
Woman: I came in April three years ago.
Man: So it's already been more than three years.

lp116.t:
A woman and a man are talking. Why did the man quit the Japanese language school?
Woman: You quit the Japanese school?
Man: Yes. Work got busy and I don't have time.
Woman: That's a shame.
Man: But I study at home every day.

lp117.t:
A man and a woman are talking. What color car did the woman buy?
Man: You bought a new car. Is it red?
Woman: I wanted red, but I chose white.
Man: Why?
Woman: The white one was cheaper.

lp118.t:
A woman and a man are talking. How many hours of TV does the man watch every day?
Woman: Do you watch TV a lot?
Man: I used to watch about three hours every day, but now only one.

lp119.t:
A man and a woman are talking. Where did the woman find her wallet?
Man: Did you find your wallet?
Woman: Yes. I searched all over my room, but it wasn't there.
Man: Where was it?
Woman: It was in the car.

lp120.t:
A woman and a man are talking. What doesn't the man like?
Woman: Do you like summer?
Man: I like the sea in summer, but I don't like the heat.
Woman: Me neither.
